No HOT setups? Zero? Zero out of zero?? You gotta be kidding me. The squeeze list is a ghost town this morning, folks, and that’s not noise—it’s a signal. When the market isn’t coughing up a single ticker with a daily score north of 90, it’s like the whole world is on the sidelines waiting for the next shoe to drop. Risk is on pause right now. Full stop. That’s the setup for today—utter indecision. So what’s the play? 

Here’s your cheat code: when the market delivers nothing but static, that’s when you zoom out and dial up the macro. A quick scan of the majors tells you we’re still stuck in the mud with the S&P 500 ($SPX) chopping sideways for weeks, the Nasdaq ($QQQ) struggling to find its next leg up, and the Russell 2000 ($IWM) grinding like it forgot it was supposed to go somewhere. Meanwhile, commodities are flatlining into a snooze fest, and the dollar ($DXY) is caught in quicksand. Translation? This is a market in search of a catalyst. 

So what happens when there’s no spark? You study the sectors, and you study them hard. Look at Energy—it’s showing signs of relative strength again. $OXY and $APA in our portfolio are nudging higher. That’s leadership. In a tape like this, you want to keep your eye on the leaders while avoiding the laggards. Speaking of laggards, let’s talk Meme stocks. $GME is holding up okay in the portfolio, but it’s clear they’ve lost the kind of juice that made them king in 2021. The market is telling us something. Are we listening? 

As for setups today, the story lies in two words: defensive rotation. There’s nothing new topping our squeeze scans, but don’t let that fool you—turn your focus back to Rare Earths, Uranium, and Crypto. These areas have been low-key grinding for weeks now, even as the wider market went into hibernation. Look at $UAMY, $UUUU, and $COIN—all strong runners that have given us multiple double-up opportunities. That’s real strength. $MP has already been a grand slam, and I want to see how $UAMY 2.0 and $UUUU keep building on these moves. New entries here? Still an option if you missed the bus earlier. The trend is intact. The tape has a way of telling us where money wants to go next, and right now, it’s whispering.

Today, I’m watching $LI and $NIO like a hawk. China’s been a quiet storm lately, and you know what they say—quiet waters run deep. If either catches steam, I want to be ready to push. And for the love of all that is holy, don’t sleep on $HIMS in Healthcare. It’s still actionable for those itching to get involved.

No setups doesn’t mean no trades. It means patience. The next move is brewing, and when it comes, I want us locked and loaded. Don’t let the silence fool you—opportunity is right around the corner. And the bears? They’ve got nothing.
